task: Fix narwhal#714: persist apisix-etcd data on a nfs-csi PVC (Deployment + Recreate strategy + Velero volume exclude, preserving #715 securityContext), add divergence detection and narwhal.io/resync recovery to scripts/cluster/lib/recover-apisix-resource-sync.sh, set sane apisix-ingress-controller periodic resync intervals (5m/15m) in scripts/cluster/08-1-networking.sh, and add R371 regression/behavioral/mutation coverage.

events.summary: Scope: Deployment/apisix-etcd persistence (apisix-etcd-data PVC + Recreate + Velero data volume exclude) in apisix-infra.yaml (shared by GitOps and 08-1-networking.sh), periodic resync intervals in 08-1-networking.sh, divergence recovery mode in recover-apisix-resource-sync.sh, R352 update + R371 check/mutation/behavioral suite, docs/lessons-log, and eval trace. Excluded: APISIX data plane (apisix.yaml), Prometheus alert rules (follow-up), and live cluster/VM mutations.

Inspected apisix-infra.yaml (Deployment/apisix-etcd used emptyDir at /var/etcd/data with uid/gid/fsGroup 10001 and readOnlyRootFilesystem=true), bundled apisix-ingress-controller-0.14.1.tgz (values.yaml and templates/configmap.yaml default apisixResourceSyncInterval='1h' and kubernetes.resyncInterval='6h'), apisix-routes.yaml render (17 ApisixRoutes / 26 http rules, 14 referenced ApisixUpstreams, 1 ApisixTls), 01-nfs-server.sh (root_squash + 5s depth-2 chmod 0777 timer), and recover-apisix-resource-sync.sh (only handled ResourceSyncAborted, missing divergence detection).

Switched apisix-etcd in apisix-infra.yaml to strategy.type=Recreate and PersistentVolumeClaim apisix-etcd-data (nfs-csi, ReadWriteOnce, 1Gi) with backup.velero.io/backup-volumes-excludes: data while keeping uid 10001 securityContext and probes intact; set config.apisixResourceSyncInterval=5m and config.kubernetes.resyncInterval=15m in 08-1-networking.sh; added --divergence/--check-divergence/--all mode to recover-apisix-resource-sync.sh using kubectl port-forward + curl -K - (secret apisix-admin-key, no key in argv/output, HTTP 404 treated as 0, narwhal.io/resync annotation until convergence); updated R352 and added R371 + docs + lessons-log.
